newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Morgan says never used RBA role for WMC gold gain.
newsitem.headline: Morgan says never used RBA role for WMC gold gain.

text.p: WMC Ltd managing director Hugh Morgan said on Thursday he had never used information obtained in his capacity as a Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) board member to benefit WMC or passed on such information to any WMC officer.
"I have never used any information which I obtained in my capacity as a Reserve Bank board member to benefit WMC," Morgan said in a statement.
Morgan said he had also never used privileged information to encourage or discourage executives of WMC to do anything that there were not already going to do.
"I have followed this principal because it is ethically correct and because it conforms with the legal and secrecy provisions I agreed to when I joined the Reserve Bank Board," Morgan said.
